onboarding.title: Set up Atap
onboarding.language.title: Pick a language
onboarding.language.hint: You can change it later in Settings.
onboarding.sync.useHint: Your OneDrive has Atap settings from another PC. Atap saves a copy of this PC's settings first, just in case.
onboarding.sync.used: Done. Your settings now come from OneDrive and stay in sync. A copy of this PC's settings is in {folder}.
onboarding.sync.failed: Atap could not save a copy of this PC's settings, so nothing changed. Try again, or pick Not now.
onboarding.sync.offerLabel: Keep my settings in sync with OneDrive
onboarding.sync.offerHint: Your settings and layout follow you to your other PCs. You can change this in Settings.
onboarding.position.title: Where should the notch sit?
onboarding.position.hint: Pick a spot. The notch moves there right away, so you can see it.
onboarding.preset.title: What would you like to see?
onboarding.preset.hint: Pick a starting point. You can add, move or remove widgets any time with Edit layout.
onboarding.preset.minimalHint: The clock, and what is playing.
onboarding.preset.studentHint: Focus timer, stopwatch, alarms and a water reminder.
onboarding.preset.workHint: Focus timer, world clock, alarms and missed alerts.
onboarding.preset.malaysiaHint: Waktu solat, Hijri date, weather, rain alerts and public holidays.
onboarding.area.title: Where are you?
onboarding.area.hint: Prayer times, weather and holidays follow your area. Nothing is fetched until you pick one.
onboarding.startup.title: Start with Windows
onboarding.startup.label: Start Atap when you sign in
onboarding.startup.hint: So the notch is there every time. You can turn this off in Settings.
onboarding.done.title: You are all set
onboarding.done.hint: Point at the notch to start. Right-click it for Settings and Edit layout.
